subtasks.description: Declare all Verilog ports, parameters, localparams (including INIT_DELAY, NCR, SEND_SIZE, SIZE, CONTENT_SIZE, Read_Delay, EIGHT_PAD, and FSM state constants), and internal registers/wires as detailed in S002, S003, S006. Generate flattened scalar declarations without unpacked arrays or multidimensional references.
constraints: Port declarations must exactly match widths and directions in S002 and S003.
Internal registers and wires must be listed as scalar signals with bit-width annotations per S006; do not use unpacked arrays or generate constructs.

subtasks.description: Instantiate exactly one sd_crc_7 submodule with ports BITVAL, Enable, CLK, RST, CRC connected as described in S016. Connect BITVAL to the appropriate single-bit CRC input signal, Enable to CRC_Enable, CLK to SD_CLK_IN, RST to CRC_RST, and CRC to the 7-bit wire CRC_VAL.
Implement a two-flip-flop synchronizer for REQ_IN to Req_internal_in using intermediate register q, clocked by SD_CLK_IN, with asynchronous active-high reset (RST_IN) as per S009.
constraints: Use asynchronous reset: on posedge SD_CLK_IN or posedge RST_IN, clear q and Req_internal_in to 0.

subtasks.description: Implement a two-flip-flop synchronizer for ACK_IN to Ack_internal_in using intermediate register q1, clocked by SD_CLK_IN, with asynchronous active-high reset (RST_IN) as per S010.
constraints: Use asynchronous reset: on posedge SD_CLK_IN or posedge RST_IN, clear q1 and Ack_internal_in to 0.

subtasks.description: Sequential command decoder block. On synchronous reset (RST_IN high), clear all internal registers and set DECODER_ACK=1. When Req_internal_in asserted, decode SETTING_IN fields per S011, capture CMD_IN into In_Buff, set Response_Size, Delay_Cycler, CRC_Check_On, block_write, block_read, word_select, and determine Write_Read/Write_Only. When Req_internal_in deasserted, clear operation flags and set DECODER_ACK=1.
constraints: Bit-field extractions must exactly match S011: Response_Size<=SETTING_IN[6:0], CRC_Check_On<=SETTING_IN[7], Delay_Cycler<=SETTING_IN[10:8], block_write<=SETTING_IN[11], block_read<=SETTING_IN[12], word_select<=SETTING_IN[14:13].
Write_Read is set when SETTING_IN[6:0]!=0, else Write_Only; mutual exclusion enforced.

subtasks.description: Combinational next-state logic for the ten-state FSM. Compute next_state from current state, Cmd_Cnt, Delay_Cnt, Write_Read, Write_Only, Req_internal_in, Ack_internal_in, cmd_dat_i, Response_Size, Delay_Cycler, block_read, block_write using the transition table in S007.
constraints: Include all states: INIT, IDLE, WRITE_WR, DLY_WR, READ_WR, DLY_READ, ACK_WR, WRITE_WO, DLY_WO, ACK_WO, plus a default to INIT.
Use binary state encoding (4 bits) and a flat case statement; do not use generate or genvar constructs.

subtasks.description: Sequential state register update. On posedge SD_CLK_IN with synchronous active-high reset (RST_IN), set state to INIT when reset, otherwise to next_state, per S008.
constraints: Use synchronous reset: if (RST_IN) state <= INIT else state <= next_state.

subtasks.description: Registered output and counter control block. On posedge SD_CLK_IN with synchronous reset (RST_IN), initialize all registers as in S012. Otherwise, based on current state, update external outputs (CMD_OUT, ACK_OUT, REQ_OUT, STATUS, cmd_oe_o, cmd_out_o, st_dat_t) and internal counters/controls (Cmd_Cnt, Delay_Cnt, Crc_Buffering, CRC_RST, CRC_Enable, CRC_OUT, CRC_Valid, word_select_counter, FSM_ACK, Out_Buff), using CRC_VAL from the sd_crc_7 instance. Follow the per-state descriptions and STATUS bit assignments in S012 and S005.
constraints: Flatten all data and control signals; avoid unpacked arrays. Derive Vector_Index and Bit_Nr from Cmd_Cnt as scalar expressions; use explicit bit selects for In_Buff/Out_Buff.
Ensure REQ_OUT/ACK_IN handshake sequencing per state descriptions.
In READ_WR, compute CRC validation exactly: compare CRC_IN with CRC_VAL after Response_Size+7 cycles, set CRC_Valid accordingly, and disable CRC afterwards.
